page0.text:
"...Whew."
I breathe out the gloom that collected in my lungs.
I'm being absurd.
How is believing in delusions supposed to help me?
If Tohsaka saw me like this, she'd be furious with me before she even got to laughing.

page1.text: "...It'll be okay. I can't move the arm, but I still have options. There's plenty of other stuff to worry about."

page2.text:
The bigger problem is Sakura, not my arm.
She seemed energetic, but she could collapse at any time.
I need to defeat Zouken and obtain the Holy Grail before then.
I can worry about myself after that.
I'll beat Zouken and Assassin with one arm.
...And they're not my only enemies.
We're facing a mysterious, unknown foe too.

page3.text:
...
I don't know the story behind it.
I have no idea what that black Shadow is, nor how Saber became Zouken's Servant.
All I know is that she's my enemy now.
